weeks.model: When I was a child, I used to play in the park after school, but I don't go there now. Since I started my new job, I have made some good friends.

items.pattern: Say what you used to do, then say what you do now: I used to ... . Now I ... .
starters: When I was a child, I used to ______ .
examples: I used to ride my bike to school. I walk to work now.

items.pattern: Say when the change started and what has changed since then: Since I started ... , I have ... .
examples: Since I started my course, I have met new people. I feel more confident now.

weeks.model: I'm going to learn to cook next month. I'm meeting my cousin on Saturday to make our first meal. If I had more time, I would learn to bake too.

items.pattern: Say what you plan to do: I'm going to ... . Then say what you have arranged: I'm meeting ... on ... .
examples: I'm going to visit my aunt next month. I'm meeting her at the station on Saturday.

items.pattern: Imagine a different situation: If I had ... , I would ... .
starters: If I had a free year, I would ______ .
If I had more money, I would ______ .
examples: If I had a free year, I would travel around Scotland. I would learn to take better photos too.

weeks.model: In our flat, you have to wash your dishes. You mustn't leave the front door open. You don't have to cook for everyone. What time do you usually leave home?

items.pattern: Give your flatmate a rule with have to, a rule with mustn't, and a choice with don't have to.
examples: You have to wash your dishes. You mustn't leave the door open. You don't have to cook for everyone.

items.pattern: Ask about your flatmate's usual day: Do you ... ? What time do you ... ?
examples: What time do you usually leave home? Do you cook in the evening?

weeks.model: The old market in my town was built a hundred years ago. Fresh bread is sold there every morning. My town is quieter than the city nearby, and it's the friendliest place I know.

items.pattern: Say when the place was built, then say what happens there now: It was built ... . It is used ... .
starters: The ______ in my town was built ______ .
examples: The old library in my town was built in 1900. Today, it is used for music classes.

items.pattern: Say how two places are different: My town is quieter than ... . Then say which place you like best.
starters: It is the ______ place I know.
examples: My town is quieter than the city nearby. It is the friendliest place I know.
